name: Andron's Ledger
summary: In the Undercity, Andron's Ledger draws the Deathstalkers' attention. A Forsaken operative has uncovered information about threats to their realm.

sections.title: Uncovering the Syndicate
sections.body: Andron Gant's bookshelf in the Undercity holds a ledger the Deathstalkers did not expect to find. Its pages show the Syndicate is moving in the region. The Syndicate is made up of remnants of Alterac's fallen human nobility. Deathstalker Mennet Carkad sees at once that Alterac's ruined lords are scheming again. The ledger gives Forsaken leadership proof of their operations beyond what the Deathstalkers expected.

sections.title: A Matter for the Dreadlord
sections.body: Mennet Carkad sends the bearer straight to Varimathras in the Royal Quarter with the ledger. It concerns threats to the Forsaken realm. Varimathras is Sylvanas Windrunner's dreadlord majordomo. He oversees internal security and espionage through the Deathstalkers. He commends the ledger, recognizing the network's competence and the operative's reliability in bringing it to light.

faq.answer: Andron's Ledger is a record book from Andron Gant's bookshelf in the Undercity. It holds intelligence the Deathstalkers seek.

Andron Gant is a Forsaken who keeps a shop near the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Lord Varimathras suspected Andron was secretly aiding an outside group. The Deathstalkers sent an agent posing as Andron's expected messenger to obtain the ledger.

faq.q: Why do the Deathstalkers want the ledger?
faq.answer: Mennet Carkad wants to examine Andron's information for intelligence useful to the Forsaken.

aliases: who do i bring the ledger to
faq.answer: The ledger goes first to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter. After evaluating its contents, he directs the bearer to deliver it straight to Lord Varimathras in the Hall of the Dark Lady.

faq.q: What does delivering the ledger achieve for a rogue?
faq.answer: Delivering the ledger earns the operative formal induction into the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken's secretive assassin guild.

angles.text: As a rogue, retrieving and deciphering Andron's Ledger proves your worth. Mennet Carkad formally inducts you into the Deathstalkers, and Varimathras acknowledges your work.
As an undead, you see how the Forsaken gather intelligence on threats around their new realm.
